info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — Governance & Access
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — Governance & Access.** Advanced roles and the role editor, SSO integration, tamper-evident audit logging with retention and compliance reports, and white-labeling.
